caption: A match pattern that is not a valid glob is refused rather than quietly reread as plain text. secreq badges the rule here and the rule never matches. That matters most on a deny: rather than let another rule's approve carry an ask your deny was written to stop, secreq asks you.

runs.text: The primary way to author auto-approvals: a sandboxed decide(ctx) function with the full power of code. Scaffold a starter project and open it in your editor.
Or add a simple declarative rule. Rules fire before the consent prompt. Deny rules win; most-specific approve wins ties.
